description: This file defines the Layer class, which manages a collection of 3D shapes and applies transformations such as rotation around specified axes. It also provides methods to start and end animations for its contained shapes.

classes.name: Layer
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of 3D shapes and allows rotating around different axes, starting and ending animations.

methods.name: Layer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layer with a specified axis and setting the identity matrix for transformation.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Iterates over contained shapes and starts their animations.

methods.name: endAnimation
methods.description: Iterates over contained shapes and ends their animations.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle for the layer around the specified axis, normalizing the angle, calculating sine and cosine, and applying the rotation to all contained shapes.
